subject: Starlite pilot: approval ladder, signature windows, and commencement protocol
messages:
From: Helen Zhao <helen.zhao@starlite.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP + target ink window for pilot

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about the latency profile on the dedicated deployment. We need to lock down a mutual action plan so our legal and procurement teams can align on the signature window. High-level asks from my side: 
- Final MAP with named approvers for legal/compliance by Friday 5/14
- Target signature window: 5/16–5/18 (we'd like to execute before month-end)
- Proposed commencement / pilot start date: 6/01, with a 30-day initial evaluation period

I've attached the draft SOW and our SSQ answers for reference (see attached: SOW_Starlite_Redwood_v1.1.docx). Can your team confirm who needs to sign and whether Redwood can accept our standard 30-day PO process?

Thanks,
Helen
Helen Zhao
Head of Product Partnerships
Starlite AI

Attachments: SOW_Starlite_Redwood_v1.1.docx, Starlite_SSQ_answers.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Helen Zhao <helen.zhao@starlite.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP + target ink window for pilot

Hi Helen — thanks for the clear ask. Draft MAP and signatory plan below (I attached a clean MAP PDF):

Proposed MAP (milestones & owners)
1) Legal review & SLA addendum finalization — Owner: Laura Bennett (Redwood Legal liaison) — target 5/14–5/15
2) Commercial approval (pricing & PO terms) — Owner: Irene Choi — target 5/15
3) Exec approval (cost exception sign-off) — Owner: Karthik Iyer — target 5/15–5/16
4) Final DocuSign envelope + signatures — Owner: Starlite (Helen/Tom) and Redwood signers queued — target 5/16–5/18

Signature windows: to avoid signatory collisions, we recommend a staggered signer schedule: Redwood signs on day 1 of the envelope (AM), customer signs in the PM, then exec countersign if required on day 2. That keeps the envelope moving and gives Legal a 24-hour window for any redlines.

Start date note: we can target a 6/01 start if the DocuSign envelope is completed by 5/18 and a PO is issued by 5/20. If procurement needs more time, we can push the start to 6/07.

Next steps I propose:
- Laura: please confirm SLA addendum redline scope and whether we need Procurement to approve payment terms.
- Karthik: can you confirm exec availability for a 5/16 quick approval if needed?
- Helen/Tom: if you can confirm final signers (I put a placeholder list in Signers_List.xlsx), I will spin the envelope and loop Legal.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Starlite_MAP_v3.pdf, Signers_List.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Helen Zhao <helen.zhao@starlite.ai>
Date: 2027-05-14T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP + target ink window for pilot

Irene / team — quick update from Legal/Ops: 
- I've reviewed the SOW and added one narrow SLA addendum item around data retention and log access. That is in Enterprise_SLA_Addendum.pdf (attached).
- We can accept Starlite's 30-day PO cadence but need the PO to reference Redwood's billing contact and remit instructions to avoid delays; procurement ops will validate when the PO arrives.
- No material redlines expected beyond the SLA addendum; if Starlite accepts the addendum text by EOD 5/15, Legal is ready to clear.

I'll stand by to join the final signature sequence and will be available for a same-day review on 5/16 if the exec wants to push.

Laura Bennett
Senior Legal Counsel (Contracts)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Enterprise_SLA_Addendum.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Helen Zhao <helen.zhao@starlite.ai>
Date: 2027-05-15T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP + target ink window for pilot

Thanks — two quick procurement notes from Finance: 
1) We can sign and countersign within the 5/16 window provided Legal clears the SLA addendum by COB 5/15. If Legal needs more time, move the envelope so our exec isn't put on a same-day ask.
2) If Starlite can issue a PO by 5/17 we can prioritize invoicing and set the pilot kickoff for the first full week of June. Our onboarding team is booked the week of 6/01, so realistic earliest fully staffed start is 6/07; we can do a soft access handoff on 6/01 if that's useful for initial validation.

I'll reserve a 15-minute slot on 5/16 at 10:30AM PT for exec quick-approve if needed. Irene — please ping me if the envelope is live.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Helen Zhao <helen.zhao@starlite.ai>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@starlite.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: FINAL: Go/no-go clearinghouse & DocuSign envelope ready

Helen / Tom — we are green on our side. Summary and actions below: 

Status summary:
- Legal (Laura): SLA addendum accepted — attached as Enterprise_SLA_Addendum.pdf
- Commercial (Irene): Pricing and SOW confirmed, SOW version 1.2 attached
- Finance (Karthik): PO timeline noted, can accelerate if PO received by 5/17

Action items (today):
- I will create the DocuSign envelope now. Planned sign order: Starlite (Tom) -> Starlite (Helen) -> Redwood Commercial (Irene) -> Redwood Exec (Karthik).
- Please confirm final signer emails in reply. If no reply by 18:00 PT we will proceed with the addresses in Signers_List.xlsx.
- Helen: if you can route PO to finance@redwood.com and include DEAL-2027-1189 we will prioritize your onboarding slot.

If everything completes in the 5/16–5/18 window we will target a soft handoff (access + test keys) on 6/01 and a staffed onboarding start on 6/07. If PO slips past 5/20, expect kickoff to move into the week of 6/14.

DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/packet/abc12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Thanks everyone — will update the envelope status once signatures begin.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_Starlite_Redwood_v1.2.docx, Signers_List.xlsx, Enterprise_SLA_Addendum.pdf
